Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Savitri - 75 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Rohan - 11 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
5. Pihu - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Savitri and Rohan stand near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kunal (happily): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Kunal scratches his head.]

Kunal: "Really?"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Kunal stands in the snow. Kavita and Pihu stand near him.]

Kunal: "Mom, look over here."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Kavita: "That's great!"

[Kunal makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Kunal: "Okay, Mom."

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Kunal: "Exactly right."

[Kunal catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal slides down the snowy slope.]

Pihu: "What next?"

Scene 3: The fishermen's village - Day

[Kunal stands in the village. Kavita and Savitri stand near him.]

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Savitri: "Exactly right."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Kavita and Savitri stand near him.]

Kavita: "Kunal, look over here."

[Kunal sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Kunal: "Okay, Grandma."

[Kunal mops the floor.]

Kunal (excited): "Okay, Grandma."

[Kunal irons his school shirt.]

Kunal: "What a day to remember!"
